    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    # A full-height guide: move the colored object next to it and put an 8
    # separator on the object's far side.
    guide_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                      if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1
                      and grid[0][c] != bg), None)
    if guide_col is not None:
        guide = grid[0][guide_col]
        cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                 if grid[r][c] not in (bg, guide)]
        left = min(c for r, c, v in cells)

        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r, c, v in cells:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c, v in cells:
            out[r][c - shift] = v

        for r in range(h):

    # A full-width guide: preserve the object and draw an 8 line below it.
    guide_row = next(r for r in range(h)

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    line = max(r for r, c in cells) + 1
    if line < h:
